# How many compatibility problems the Plugin Verifier currently reports for each
# IDE, and therefore how many the Marketplace will show against the plugin page.
#
# verify.yml fails when a number goes up and tells you when one goes down.
#
# All zero since #144 moved the Java and TestNG code into content modules of
# their own. Before that the three IDEs without those plugins reported 53 apiece
# - every PSI and TestNG reference in the core jar, which the verifier could not
# tell was guarded. A number rising above 0 now means a class that needs an
# optional plugin has been written into the core jar again.
IU 0
PY 0
GO 0
WS 0
